loading.error: The press jammed. Something didn’t load.

title.subtitle: The Unprinted Wood
title.tagline: Your crystal sheds ink, not light.

tutorial.move: Drag on the left side of the screen to walk
tutorial.moveKeys: Use W A S D or the arrow keys to walk
tutorial.crystal: Hold on the right side to grow the ink light
tutorial.crystalKeys: Hold Shift or the right mouse button to grow the ink light
tutorial.bolt: Tap on the right side to fire an ink bolt
tutorial.boltKeys: Click to fire an ink bolt
tutorial.dash: Swipe on the right side to dash
tutorial.print: Hold the ink light over a sketch until it prints
tutorial.printKeys: Hold Shift near a sketch until it prints

pause.title: Paused
pause.subtitle: The ink is drying…
pause.confirm: Close this issue? You’ll restart from your last checkpoint.

settings.title: Settings
settings.leftHandedHint: Joystick on the right, actions on the left
settings.reduceMotionHint: No line boil, shake or flashes
settings.misregistrationHint: Slightly offset colour plates, like old print
settings.ghostHint: A pencil ghost replays your best run of the page

a2hs.text: Keep this issue on your shelf — add INKWAKE to your home screen. It plays offline.
a2hs.ios: Tap {icon} Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.

rule.doubleGhosts: Today: the ghosts come in pairs.
rule.inkPuddles: Today: every ghost you ink spills a puddle of ink.
rule.thickFog: Today: the fog sits thick on every page.
rule.longMemory: Today: the paper never forgets your ink.

caption.scratchHint: Tap three times to scratch it out

nearDeath.0: One page left. The kid was running out of story.
nearDeath.1: The paper was tearing. So was the kid's luck.
nearDeath.2: A single page between the wizard and the waste bin.

firstKill.0: The first ghost went down in ink. It wouldn't be the last.
firstKill.1: One less smudge on my clean white page.
firstKill.2: So the kid could draw blood. Ink, anyway.

damage.0: That one tore a page right out of him.
damage.1: The forest bit. The forest always bites.

lowInk.0: The bottle was nearly dry. Nights like this, they always are.
lowInk.1: Low on ink. Low on time. Low on friends.
lowInk.2: Every drop counted now. I was counting.

idle.0: The kid stood there. The page waited. I don't wait.
idle.1: Standing still on a blank page. Bold choice.
idle.2: Nothing moved in the wood. Not yet.
idle.3: I could rewrite you while you stand there, kid.

multiKill.0: Three ghosts, three blots. The page was getting crowded.
multiKill.1: He inked them faster than I could draw them.

threat.crystalOut: And then the crystal went out.
threat.fogIn: And then the fog rolled in.
threat.ghostsHaste: And then the ghosts got hungry.
threat.inkDrought: And then the ink ran dry.
